PAINTING & BODYWORK · Body Repair

Body & Collision Repair in Riyadh

Collision and body repair for premium vehicles in Riyadh: structural assessment, panel repair and refinishing at QSC's dedicated painting & bodywork facility.

  1. Home
  2. Painting & Bodywork
  3. Body & Collision Repair

After a collision, the visible dent is the least important part of the assessment. Modern luxury bodies mix steels, aluminium and bonded structures that absorb energy in designed ways — so the first question is always what the impact did beneath the surface. QSC's body repair begins with structural assessment and measurement where indicated, separates what must be replaced from what can be properly repaired, and finishes with refinishing that stands up to inspection.

Collision repair on modern luxury vehicles is governed by the manufacturer's repair methods — documents that specify, panel by panel, what may be straightened, what must be replaced, where sectioning is permitted and which joints are bonded, riveted or welded. These rules exist because mixed-material bodies behave as engineered systems in the next crash: a repair that ignores them can look perfect and protect worse. QSC repairs to the published method for each vehicle, and when a client asks why a panel cannot simply be pulled straight, the method document is the answer shown.

The sequence after a collision also matters more than owners expect. Insurance assessment, structural measurement, parts ordering and disassembly interact — and a workshop that disassembles before approvals or orders before measuring creates delays it then blames on others. QSC runs the sequence transparently: assessment and documentation first, a defined scope agreed with insurer or owner, parts confirmed, then repair in one continuous flow with the vehicle never opened longer than necessary.

When to book this service

  • Collision damage — from a parking knock to a serious accident
  • Panel gaps that changed, doors or boot that no longer close cleanly
  • Visible deformation, cracked paint lines or misaligned trim after an impact
  • An insurance or private repair you want done to a high standard

How QSC handles it

Damage assessment including structure behind the visible panels

Chassis measurement where the impact pattern calls for it

Repair or replacement of affected panels and components to a defined scope

Refinishing, reassembly, panel-gap setting and final inspection

Why QSC for this service

  • Repairs follow the manufacturer's published method for each vehicle — not habit
  • Structural measurement before and after where the impact pattern calls for it
  • A transparent sequence with insurer and owner — no surprise scope growth

Cost and time — honestly

Pricing at QSC follows the assessment, never precedes it: after evaluation you receive the proposed scope and its cost for approval, and only what you approve is carried out. Durations are estimated realistically per job — we publish no blanket promises we could not keep for every case.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Do you work with insurance claims?

Bring your claim details to the assessment; the team will tell you plainly how the process works with your insurer and what documentation the workshop provides.

The damage looks small. Do I really need an assessment?

Small visible damage can hide displaced structure, broken clips or sensor mounts — especially on bumpers packed with radar and cameras. A quick assessment is how you find out whether it really is small.

Will the repaired area be noticeable?

The goal of proper body repair is that it is not — correct panel repair, paint matching and finishing exist for exactly that reason. Where any limitation exists for your specific damage, you are told before the work, not after.

My car was hit while parked. What are my first steps?

Photograph everything before the car is moved — wide shots, close-ups, the other party's details if available. Then call us before authorizing anything anywhere else: an early assessment protects you from both under-repair and inflated scope, and we can advise on the insurance sequence from the start.
